The training

Two methods that make every set count.

Hi Sarah,

Here's what the training in Rock the Fall actually looks like.

I built the program around two techniques. Both help you build strength and muscle in less time, which matters when your schedule is already full.

Watch me break it down

The 6-12-25 method

One muscle group. Three exercises. No rest in between. You start heavy, finish light, and get more done in less time.

Mechanical advantage training

When a movement gets too hard, you switch to an easier variation and keep going. You push further without breaking form.

Hardest variation→Easier→Keep going
